header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH AT KARACHI
Date Order with signature of Judge
body: Dated: 09.04.2024 Mr. Hasham Ahmed Khan for appellants.

-.-.- Learned counsel for appellants submits that the dispute between them and respondent is settled out of Court amicably as such they (appellants) have instructed not to press this appeal, which is accordingly dismissed as not pressed.
